content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lake Charles

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years of experience. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria now to verify you meet the education and experience thresholds before investing in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend all sessions from your Lake Charles location on a schedule that fits your work at CITGO, Venture Global LNG, Turner Industries, or other regional employers—no travel required.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, complete and submit your PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of your education and project-management experience. Pay PMI's exam fee at the time of application to secure your testing appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study guides, to reinforce core concepts. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner and complete the assessment at an approved testing center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Your PMP remains valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved learning activities, project work, and community involvement to keep your credential active and stay current in the field.
